items.t: Upper ball joint wear and separation (recall 04V-596)
items.job: Replace front upper ball joints and align
items.note: Covered by recall for affected 4x4 models. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Exterior lights can fail from timer module fault (recall 02V-322)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor can quit (recall 04V-216)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Power outlet connector short and fire risk (recall 06V-339)
items.note: Covered by recall. Any heat damage to nearby wiring adds cost.

items.t: Instrument panel fire risk from gauge cluster circuit (recalls 03V-528, 07V-092)
items.job: Install fuse and repair gauge cluster circuit
items.note: Covered by recalls. A replacement gauge cluster would cost much more.

items.t: Battery cable can chafe and short (recall 04V-578)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Throttle cable can stick open (recall 04V-020)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Vehicle may roll away in Park (recall 05V-460)
items.job: Inspect and repair transmission park mechanism
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: ABS control module needs reprogramming (recall 05V-554)
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rear Watts link can fail (recall 06V-240)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor can stop working (recall 06V-067)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump relay failure in the power module (recalls)
items.note: The recall fix adds an external relay at no charge. Check your VIN before paying for a new module.

items.t: Brake booster corrosion (recalls)
items.note: Covered by recalls. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Alternator failure (recalls)
items.note: Some years are covered by an alternator recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer first.

items.t: Left cylinder head valve seat problem (warranty extension)
items.note: Chrysler's 10-year/150,000-mile extension has likely expired. Still ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Oil filter housing and oil cooler leaks
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler assembly
items.note: Use the updated aluminum-style housing. Coolant may need to be refilled too.

items.t: Lifter and camshaft wear
items.note: If metal has spread through the engine, a replacement engine costs much more.

items.t: ABS module fault (recalls)
items.job: Reprogram or replace ABS control module
items.note: Covered by recalls. Low end is a software update; high end is a new module.

items.t: Steering rack can bind (recall 22V-154)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear spoiler can crack and come loose (recalls)
items.note: Covered by recalls. Check your VIN first.
